mechanism: Both drugs are hepatically metabolized and can compete for metabolism; pyrazinamide may increase ciprofloxacin levels while ciprofloxacin may inhibit uric acid excretion exacerbating pyrazinamide-induced hyperuricemia.
action: Monitor for ciprofloxacin toxicity and gout/hyperuricemia symptoms; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antibiotics if hyperuricemia develops; routine use in TB therapy is acceptable with monitoring.
